privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how Kotikassa handles personal data when you create an account, share a household budget, and optionally scan receipts.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: The data controller for Kotikassa is:
controller.name: Controller

data.title: Data we collect
data.intro: The categories of personal data depend on the features you use:

items.account: Account data, including your email address, display name, authentication identifier, avatar and sign-in provider.
items.household: Household financial data you enter or share, such as expenses, income, budgets, savings, investments, recurring costs and information about people you track.
items.receipts: Receipt images and extracted receipt details, including merchant, date, purchased items, prices and any other information visible in the uploaded image.
items.technical: Technical and security information processed by our hosting, authentication and monitoring providers, such as IP address, device/browser information, request logs and error diagnostics.
items.preferences: App preferences, language, currency, category choices and your recorded privacy choices.

purposes.title: Why we process data
purposes.intro: We process personal data only for identified purposes and legal bases:

items.service: To create your account and provide the household budgeting service you request. The legal basis is performance of the service requested by you.
items.scanning: To analyse receipt images with OpenAI when you enable receipt scanning. The legal basis is your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.
items.training: To develop, test and evaluate Kotikassa's own receipt-reading models only when you separately allow it. The legal basis is your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.
items.security: To secure, troubleshoot and improve reliability, prevent abuse and enforce usage limits. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating a safe and reliable service.
items.legal: To comply with applicable legal obligations and respond to lawful requests.

recipients.title: Service providers and recipients
recipients.intro: We use the following providers to operate Kotikassa. They process data only for their relevant service:

items.supabase: Supabase provides authentication, the application database and receipt-image storage.
items.vercel: Vercel hosts and delivers the web application and processes related request logs.
items.openai: OpenAI processes a compressed receipt image only when you use optional receipt scanning.
items.sentry: Sentry receives technical error diagnostics used to find and repair application failures.
items.google: Google processes authentication information if you choose Google sign-in.

scanning.title: Optional receipt scanning
scanning.body: Receipt scanning is optional. When enabled, the selected image is compressed and sent through Kotikassa's server to OpenAI for item extraction. The API key is never exposed to your browser. OpenAI API data is not used to train OpenAI models by default. OpenAI may retain abuse-monitoring logs for up to 30 days. The same compressed image is stored with the receipt after you save it.
scanning.training: After your first eligible saved scan, Kotikassa asks once whether it may use that receipt and future eligible receipt images with your confirmed corrections to develop, test and evaluate its own receipt-reading models. Choosing Not now does not affect the app. You can change this choice later in Privacy Choices.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.intro: We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes described above:

items.account: Account and profile data is kept while your account is active and removed when the applicable account-deletion process completes.
items.family: Shared household records remain with the household until they are deleted or the household is deleted. If a member leaves, shared records may remain without that member's account identifier.
items.receipts: Saved receipt images and extracted data remain until the associated data or household is deleted.
items.training: A receipt is included in a newly generated model-development dataset only while current permission and its receipt-level consent record are valid. Withdrawal prevents future exports and marks that user's saved receipts ineligible for new datasets.
items.openai: OpenAI abuse-monitoring logs may be retained for up to 30 days; Kotikassa requests that API responses are not stored for product features.
items.technical: Hosting and error-monitoring logs are retained according to configured operational retention periods and provider requirements.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Some service providers may process data outside Finland or the European Economic Area. Where required, providers use recognised safeguards for international transfers, such as European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses.

sharing.title: Household sharing
sharing.body: Kotikassa is a shared household application. Members of the same household can see shared financial records and receipt details. Private savings goals remain visible only to their creator. Do not upload information you are not authorised to share with other household members.

security.title: Security
security.body: Kotikassa uses authenticated sessions, database row-level security, server-side API credentials and encrypted network connections. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so report suspected unauthorised access promptly.

rights.title: Your data-protection rights
rights.intro: Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:

items.access: Request access to personal data held about you.
items.correct: Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
items.delete: Request deletion of your personal data.
items.restrict: Request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.
items.portability: Receive eligible data in a portable format.
items.object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests.
items.withdraw: Withdraw receipt-scanning or receipt-model-development consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.
items.complain: Lodge a complaint with the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman in Finland or another competent supervisory authority.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: When this notice changes materially, Kotikassa will increment its version and present the updated notice to signed-in users before they continue.

contact.title: Questions and requests
contact.body: Contact the controller using the email address above for privacy questions, rights requests or suspected data incidents. We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.
